blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — By turning decades of earthquake research into practical safety measures for communities and schoolchildren, Myanmar geologist-seismologist Hla Hla Aung has helped strengthen disaster preparedness across Southeast Asia, earning her the 2026 Asean Prize. President Marcos and Asean Secretary General Kao Kim Hourn presented the award to Aung, 79, during the opening ceremony
